name: Lenovo ThinkStation PGX (GB10, 128 GB unified)
cpu: 10x Cortex-X5 + 10x Cortex-A725 (big.LITTLE), same as DGX Spark
gpu: Blackwell, SM121, same as DGX Spark
notes: Same GB10 silicon, memory and bandwidth as the NVIDIA DGX Spark in a Lenovo chassis; CUDA behaviour matches, so engine recipes transfer.
Kept as its own class because reported numbers name this box, and OEM firmware/power limits can differ from NVIDIA's reference board.
Ollama and containerised SGLang/vLLM paths behave as on Spark; treat Spark numbers as comparable but not identical.

compute.cpu_cores: 20-core Arm, same GB10 silicon as DGX Spark (10x Cortex-X925-class + 10x Cortex-A725)
compute.note: Same GB10 chip as the DGX Spark, so NVIDIA's published FP4-sparse peak applies; Lenovo does not publish separate compute figures for PGX.

storage.note: capacity and read rate not published by Lenovo

thermal.note: Lenovo does not publish chip-level TDP for PGX; OEM firmware/power limits may differ from NVIDIA's reference board, which is why this stays its own class

sources.note: GB10 chip specifications (shared silicon: 128 GB LPDDR5x, 273 GB/s, 1 PFLOP FP4 sparse)
